event.name: FEINVILLE
event.venueDetail: DavSavana, 1st left on Minita Rd, Obirikwere, Port Harcourt
event.detailLine: 01.11.26 · 4–10PM · DavSavana, 1st left on Minita Rd, Obirikwere, Port Harcourt
event.posterAlt: Breaktime Presents FEINVILLE poster: a many-eyed chrome spider over a red-lit crowd and palm trees, 01.11.26, 4–10PM, DavSavana, Obirikwere, Port Harcourt.

texts.whyIntro1: FIENVILLE is a Garden City underground experience.
texts.whyIntro2: A collaboration between Break Time & Nairaboyz, bringing together their people, their friends, and some of the best young creatives coming out of Port Harcourt.
texts.whyCommands:
Come to hang out.
Come to rage.
Come to dance.
Come to hear something new.
Come with your people.
Leave with new ones.
texts.whyExpect: Expect live performances, DJs, mosh pits, heavy sounds, crazy energy and a room full of Garden City people going all the way out.
texts.whyCommands2:
No stiff crowd.
No standing at the back.
Get involved.
texts.whyClosing: This is where the underground comes together.
texts.whySignBy:
BREAK TIME × NAIRABOYZ
🕷️ NO SWAG. NO ENTRY.
texts.aboutReveal: Break Time is a Port Harcourt creative community and development platform by Red Earth Labs. We run nights, sessions, listening parties and open discussions for people who make things, so they can meet, get inspired and build with each other.
texts.missionTitle: Put Port Harcourt's creatives in the same room.
texts.missionBody: We run nights, sessions, listening parties and open discussions for people who make things, so they can meet, get inspired and build with each other.
texts.visionTitle: A Port Harcourt scene that is connected and visible.
texts.visionBody: A creative community that backs its own, shows up for each other, and keeps growing well beyond any single night.
texts.radioStripText: Mixes, sessions and listening parties are coming. We'll say when it's on.
texts.eventsLede: Break Time editions, sessions and listening parties in Port Harcourt.
texts.rulesIntro: Read these before you come. They apply to everyone in the room.
texts.clubBlurb: Creatives in Port Harcourt and across Nigeria. Music, fashion, art, tech. [PERKS: ONE LINE]

rules.title: Bags are checked at the door.
Respect the room.
rules.body: No harassment, no unwanted touching, no hate.

rules.title: The pit is for people who want in.
rules.body: Keep it rough, not violent. If someone goes down, pick them up.

rules.title: Look out for your people.
rules.body: If something is wrong, find the crew.

rules.title: The crew has the final say.
rules.body: Ignore them and you can be asked to leave.
